description: This file defines data structures and methods related to device configuration in cgroups, including device rules, permissions, and device types.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device with associated rules, path, permissions, and ownership.

classes.name: Permissions
classes.description: String type representing device access permissions with set operations.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Defines a device rule including type, major/minor numbers, permissions, and allow flag.

methods.name: toSet
methods.description: Converts Permissions string to a set of permission bits.

methods.name: fromSet
methods.description: Creates Permissions string from a set of permission bits.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Returns the union of two Permissions sets.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Returns the difference between two Permissions sets.

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two Permissions sets.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if Permissions set is empty.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if Permissions set is valid.

methods.name: CgroupString
methods.description: Returns string representation of a Rule in cgroup format.

methods.name: Mkdev
methods.description: Generates device number from a Rule.
